## Project thoughts

I am interested in exploring data related to Artificial Intelligence infrastructure implementation in communities across the United States. I would like to look at data centers, AI companies being trademarked, and public opinion data on the local response. It could be interesting to look at environmental consequences of AI expansion as well.
